title: Fellowship Meeting
summary: The meeting started exactly at 08.05am . The meeting was held at Daffodil 1 The Fern Residency Mira Road.
description:
The meeting started exactly at 08.05am .
The meeting was held at Daffodil 1 The Fern Residency Mira Road.
Total attendees were total 11 members in attendance
The meeting kick started the meeting with Pre Vimal calling for everyone to rise to sing the National Anthem.

The four way test was recited by Rtn Amit Pandey the sergeant of Arms of the club.
In the absence of district sports of our club Rtn Afzal club Vice President spoke & mentioned to the club members that the club had won the cricket team tournament last year.

Rtn Faisal Shaikh also spoke about Discon 2026 scheduled for Feb 2027 & insisted tat all Rotarians must attend the event.

Rtn Niharicaa introduced Kenneth to the club members who spent 25 years in music composing to now running a social welfare institute Grameen First Foundations from Mokada to help the tribal community in healthcare ,self sustainable
